subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu group chat: slash commands like /new, /status, and /model do not work and may lose message content

question: Should Feishu slash commands with no explicit command allowlist inherit already-admitted Feishu sender access, or should the shared command-gating helper change for every channel?
rationale: Both approaches can fix the user symptom, but the shared-helper approach changes the command authorization default for all channels using access groups, while the Feishu-scoped approach needs a clear owner contract for already-admitted Feishu senders.

options.title: Prefer Feishu-scoped inheritance
options.body: Authorize Feishu text commands for senders already admitted by Feishu DM/group policy when no Feishu command allowlist is configured, while preserving explicit allowlist denial.

options.title: Approve shared gate change
options.body: Change `resolveCommandAuthorizedFromAuthorizers` globally so all-unconfigured access-group command authorizers are allowed, with cross-channel security and upgrade tests.

options.title: Keep fail-closed default
options.body: Require explicit command allowlists for Feishu control commands and document the operator action instead of changing runtime defaults.

recommendation.title: Prefer Feishu-scoped inheritance
recommendation.body: Authorize Feishu text commands for senders already admitted by Feishu DM/group policy when no Feishu command allowlist is configured, while preserving explicit allowlist denial.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for both the shared command gate and the Feishu policy migration is on steipete-authored commits.
